entries.title: Late Ford truck field reference
entries.summary: Ford F-Series style jobs need key-system confirmation before committing to prox, flip, or transponder workflow.

alternates: Confirm emergency insert or door profile before cutting

lishi.primary: HU101 or HU198 by confirmed blade profile
alternates: Do not pick tool from VIN alone

origination: Confirm prox vs flip/transponder from ignition/start button and customer-visible key style
Confirm blade profile before cutting a test key
unlock: Watch weatherstrip, wiring, and cab configuration
programming: Confirm FDRS/OEM path need before opening security functions
Use stable voltage support during programming
access: Photograph VIN plate and door jamb label
Document authorization before entry or key generation
jobFlow: Confirm button layout and insert profile
decodePlan: Use authorized code source when available
If decoding, verify door read against insert/ignition behavior before final cut
cutting: Verify center-mill profile and jaw setup
Cut and test mechanical function before programming electronics
partVerification: Confirm FCC, frequency, board, buttons, panic, remote start, and tailgate/hatch options
Treat similar-looking Ford remotes as different until identifiers are verified
warnings: Late Ford truck prox/flip options can split by trim and equipment
VIN confirms vehicle identity, not final button layout or board

entries.title: Late Toyota hybrid prox reference
entries.summary: Late Toyota hybrid work needs prox/insert/FCC verification and a programmer path check before committing.

keyway.primary: Toyota emergency insert keyway must be confirmed

lishi.primary: Toyota keyway-specific Lishi after insert verification

jobFlow: Confirm FCC and emergency insert before selecting key package
Verify programmer coverage before security functions
partVerification: Confirm FCC, board, emergency insert, and button layout
Hybrid trim and package can change correct prox
warnings: Do not select Toyota prox from year/model alone
Online/security access may be the deciding factor
